name: Hand AR Interfaces 3
summary:
Your hands become the starting point for a collection of spatial interface experiments. Browse the catalogue, choose an interface and explore how different gestures can control objects and information in mixed reality.

Try fingertip faders, explore a miniature space, turn the pages of a book, draw and experiment with other hand-centred interactions. Use the in-app guidance and catalogue to move between experiences.
